Name: Pretty Anime Misc. Shops
Author: SerDakota
Description:
[b]These portraits were made with Ai.[/b]

I included a list of shops this mod covers below. Every shop has three variants a default, a version of them in an apron, and a NSFW with nudity. Every shop can be changed individually as well. This is designed to work with Shop Portrait Framework and will NOT function without it. 

I did not upload every shop obviously but the pictures are examples of the kind of content you can expect. 

Best used along my portrait mod Pretty Anime Portraits for a consistent style. 
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38134?tab=posts&BH=0
